svg.title: Proposed ACP execution — invocation context + sandbox stdio transport

g.text: Proposed ACP execution — invocation context + sandbox stdio transport

g.data-entity: Engine ACP adapter . proposed provider location
g.id: cluster_Engine ACP adapter . proposed provider location
g.text: Engine ACP adapter — proposed provider location
ADD in graph runtime / Engine adapter:
typed SandboxSpec extension and per-node resolver.
Do not store invocation state on shared providers.
Do not serialize secrets into continuations or events.
propagate context through fresh and resume paths,
built-in providers and minimal library ACPNode.
Direct connect() calls still work with context=None.
Custom providers must adopt the new signature.
ADD at the Engine adapter boundary:
composition injects the selected Sandbox backend
map host workspace to sandbox workspace.
ACP new/load cwd is the guest absolute path.
Apply translation on both new and loaded sessions.
Client close / handshake failure exits owned sandbox.
protocol handling must not require subprocess-only
Sandbox cleanup must stop the guest, not just its CLI.
Preserve the existing 8 MiB ACP message budget.
Explicit configuration is a deliberate grant.
SandboxSpec.secrets wins over conflicting command env.
Guest PATH / HOME / temp paths use guest values.
Verify the entire effective agent environment,
Disposable VM deletion also deletes agent session state.
Passing context alone does not make session/load durable.
Define persistence before claiming restart recovery;
unavailable state must fail explicitly, never start fresh silently.
Result export remains explicit copy_out, without automatic host merge.
Host MCP reachability needs validation or the planned bridge (#678).
Credential lifecycle remains follow-up #676; acceptance uses explicit test secrets.
context forwarded on fresh AND resume
exec(guest command, relative cwd, explicit env)
ACP JSON-RPC over sandbox exec stdio
Dashed triangle arrows = implements / extends; solid arrows = call / data flow.
Proposed names and locations are planning decisions, not implemented code.
Acceptance: real Codex AND Claude nodes complete inside SmolVM;
tests assert the full environment key set and cleanup on failure / cancellation.
